turns.question: Who spent more per order in September 2026, our Turkish or our Dutch customers, and what was their average?
turns.answer: In September 2026 (1 to 30 September), Turkish customers spent slightly more per order, with an average order value of 109.64 EUR, compared with 109.45 EUR for Dutch customers. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
